title: Quantum Computing-Based Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks for Airfoil Parameterization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Airfoil geometry parameterization is essential in aerodynamic design optimization. Optimization search in the large space suffers from low efficiency and modest feasible region, which could further incur failures to convergence. Generative adversarial networks (GAN), aiming to learn the statistical distribution of existing data, pave a new avenue for shape generation and airfoil parameterization. GAN manages to implicitly reduce design space by generating only smooth, realistic airfoils. translated_title: 基于量子计算的Wasserstein生成对抗网络翼型参数化方法
translated_abstract: 翼型几何参数化在气动设计优化中至关重要。在大设计空间中进行优化搜索存在效率低、可行域有限的问题，甚至可能导致收敛失败。生成对抗网络（GAN）旨在学习现有数据的统计分布，为形状生成和翼型参数化开辟了新途径。GAN通过仅生成光滑、逼真的翼型，能够隐式地缩减设计空间。与此同时，量子计算在特定类型的工程问题中日益展现出实现卓越性能的巨大潜力，但尚未被引入翼型参数化领域。为填补这一空白，本工作开发了基于量子计算的Wasserstein生成对抗网络（Q-WGAN），并研究了其在翼型参数化中的性能。Q-WGAN采用参数化量子电路作为生成器，以提升生成性能。
tldr: 本文首次将量子计算引入翼型参数化领域，提出采用参数化量子电路作为生成器的量子Wasserstein生成对抗网络（Q-WGAN），以隐式缩减设计空间并提升气动设计优化的生成性能。
en_tdlr: This work introduces quantum computing into airfoil parameterization for the first time, proposing a Q-WGAN that employs parameterized quantum circuits as the generator to implicitly reduce the design space and enhance generative performance in aerodynamic design optimization.
